messages:
maya: Heads-up: final run-through for our "Reframe: Inference in Production" webinar this Thu at 11am PT. Need to lock reg page CTA, Zoom cohosts, recording passes, and post-event clip plan. Reg URL: https://redwood.ai/events/reframe-inference?utm=slack

olivia: Can we make the CTA less jargon-y? Current says 'Join our inference runbook'  feels like only engs will click. Suggest: 'Live demo: how production LLMs power products'

maya: Good—I'll iterate that copy. Also decision on auto-transcript + SRT export? We want SRT, captions ON, and SRT export to GCS.

tom: I got Zoom. I'll add cohosts: maya, tom, sophie. Enable cloud recording, audio transcription, and alternative host for presenters. Also can enable local recording prompt for presenters so we can get separate webcam tracks if they record locally. Config snippet I will confirm in account: ```
record_meeting: true
recording_storage: cloud
audio_transcription: true
auto_delete_days: 30
```

sophie: I'll own clip edits + HubSpot tagging. Need raw MP4 + SRT. Plan: immediate 3-min teaser email, 24h 60-90s highlight, 48h full replay + transcript. Will include a 1-question survey in the first email.

zach: Ops: use service account events-ingest@redwood-prod to copy Zoom cloud recordings to gs://redwood-events/reframe-2026/raw/. Ops-bot will run transfer. After trimming, we'll archive final assets to gs://redwood-events/reframe-2026/archive/ with 365d lifecycle. Ensure SA has storage.objectAdmin.

ops-bot: job-scheduler: recording-transfer queued for 2026-03-24T12:05Z

ops-bot: job-run: recording-transfer started -> scanning /zoom/redwood-reframe/*

ops-bot: job-run: recording-transfer success -> files uploaded to gs://redwood-events/reframe-2026/raw/ (mp4 + srt)

olivia: Requesting presenter webcam tracks. Zoom cloud doesn't reliably split them. Ask presenters to hit 'record locally' and upload via shared folder if they can. I'll send a short checklist.

maya: Please schedule a greenroom dry-run Wed 10:30 PT. Tom, can you DM presenters the checklist (local rec, headphones, mute other devices, avoid virtual backgrounds)?

tom: Will do. Also add a registration checkbox to capture job title for segmentation: 'Share my job title'. Sophie: can you map that to HubSpot property event_job_title?

sophie: Yep. I'll add event_segment=webinar_reframe and create the HubSpot workflow to send the three-step nurture. Also prepping Notion task for editors: trims, highlights, SRT, CSV timestamps.

maya: CTA copy options: (A) 'Live demo: production LLM inference' (B) 'See how product teams run LLMs at scale' Thoughts?

olivia: I prefer B  more user-centric.

tom: Shorter A reads better in CTAs. Either works.

zach: Ops checklist post-event: 1) verify cloud + any local uploads present, 2) confirm ops-bot transfer success, 3) move final edits to archive-bucket, 4) set HubSpot properties + event_segment, 5) schedule nurture emails.

maya: Solid. For post-event clips: Sophie will own editorial; Olivia will request webcam splits from presenters if available. Dry-run Wed 10:30 PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
